about: Homework for this pillar, one list per AI (Claude writes it; tools/kit/render.py in jpavia10/prometheus-hub turns it into docs/agents/QUEUE_{ai}.md and the Drive docs). Every task says exactly what to read, what to make, how many, where to save it, how Claude checks it and what makes it not done. A task is done only when the file passes the checks, never because it was sent.

tasks.title: Icarus Stake: the spec sheet (a high-risk trading journal: positions, entries, exits, P/L, the rules Joseph sets for himself; it never places a trade)
tasks.why: Icarus Stake is a seat on the desk with no page yet. Joseph wants each pillar developed on its own; the first step is a spec Claude can build from.
steps: Write the spec for Icarus Stake: a high-risk trading journal: positions, entries, exits, P/L, the rules Joseph sets for himself; it never places a trade.
At least 6 data sources with their real API names and documentation URLs (open each one); say plainly when something has no public API.
Four first screens, each listing every number on it and where it comes from.
Five 'done when' checks that can be tested on a phone.
No broker keys in the browser; read-only exports or manual entry only. It never trades.

deliver.shape: one markdown file with these 6 headings, in this order: 1 Purpose (one sentence) | 2 Data sources (a table: source | what it gives | how to get it (API name) | docs URL | sign-in type | cost | limits) | 3 First four screens (for each: its name, every number and list on it, where each comes from) | 4 Version 1 done when (5 checks Claude can test) | 5 Privacy (what never leaves the device) | 6 What Joseph must do once (accounts, keys, apps)

tasks.done_when: All 6 headings, at least 6 sources with working docs URLs, 4 screens, 5 testable checks.
checks: Claude checks each 'done when' can be tested without asking Joseph.
rejected_if: a row copied from another row with the names changed
a source URL that does not open or does not say what the row claims
fewer items than the count
a file saved anywhere but the folder named here, or under another name
an API that does not exist or a docs URL for something else
a screen that lists a number with no source

tasks.title: 25 journal metrics, each formula worked on the same 20 trades
tasks.why: Icarus shows win rate, expectancy, profit factor and drawdown today; it needs the rest with formulas Claude can test.
steps: The 20 trades (made up): t1 2026-01-05 AAPL long 10 @190.00 exit 196.50 stop 186.00 fees 1.00 kept yes; t2 2026-01-06 TSLA long 5 @250.00 exit 241.00 stop 244.00 fees 1.00 kept no; t3 2026-01-07 SPY short 4 @480.00 exit 474.00 stop 485.00 fees 1.00 kept yes; t4 2026-01-08 NVDA long 3 @500.00 exit 520.00 stop 490.00 fees 1.00 kept yes; t5 2026-01-09 AMD long 20 @150.00 exit 147.00 stop 147.00 fees 1.00 kept yes; t6 2026-01-12 QQQ short 6 @410.00 exit 415.00 stop 414.00 fees 1.00 kept no; t7 2026-01-13 MSFT long 8 @380.00 exit 392.00 stop 374.00 fees 1.00 kept yes; t8 2026-01-14 META long 5 @360.00 exit 351.00 stop 354.00 fees 1.00 kept no; t9 2026-01-15 AMZN long 10 @155.00 exit 158.10 stop 152.00 fees 1.00 kept yes; t10 2026-01-16 IWM short 15 @200.00 exit 197.00 stop 202.00 fees 1.00 kept yes; t11 2026-01-20 GOOG long 12 @140.00 exit 138.00 stop 137.00 fees 1.00 kept yes; t12 2026-01-21 NFLX long 2 @480.00 exit 505.00 stop 470.00 fees 1.00 kept yes; t13 2026-01-22 COIN long 10 @130.00 exit 118.00 stop 124.00 fees 1.00 kept no; t14 2026-01-23 SPY long 4 @478.00 exit 484.00 stop 474.00 fees 1.00 kept yes; t15 2026-01-26 BA short 6 @210.00 exit 214.50 stop 214.00 fees 1.00 kept yes; t16 2026-01-27 JPM long 10 @170.00 exit 174.00 stop 167.00 fees 1.00 kept yes; t17 2026-01-28 SHOP long 15 @75.00 exit 72.00 stop 73.00 fees 1.00 kept no; t18 2026-01-29 AAPL long 10 @192.00 exit 192.00 stop 189.00 fees 1.00 kept yes; t19 2026-01-30 XOM short 10 @105.00 exit 101.00 stop 107.00 fees 1.00 kept yes; t20 2026-02-02 TSLA long 5 @240.00 exit 228.00 stop 234.00 fees 1.00 kept no. Bankroll at the start: 10,000.00. 'kept' = the trade kept the rules.

25 metrics: net P/L, win rate, average win, average loss, payoff ratio, expectancy per trade, expectancy in R (R = entry-stop distance x qty), profit factor, max drawdown in dollars and percent, longest losing streak, Sharpe per trade, Sortino per trade, Kelly fraction, SQN, average R, cost of broken rules (P/L of kept=no trades), win rate when kept=yes vs no, largest loss in R, recovery factor, ulcer index, gain-to-pain, average hold (all 1 day), percent of trades over 2R, fees share of gross.
For each: the formula in words and in symbols, a primary source (a book with page, or a paper DOI; Van Tharp for SQN and R, Kelly 1956 for Kelly), and the value on the 20 trades to 4 decimals.
tasks.done_when: 25 metrics, every value matches Claude's own calculation on the 20 trades.
checks: Claude computes all 25 in Python; a value off by more than 0.001 fails the row; 3 fails = the file is sent back.

tasks.title: Risk-of-ruin table: 135 cells from one cited formula
tasks.why: A high-risk journal should show how likely a 50 % drawdown is at the risk Joseph takes per trade.
steps: Pick one closed-form risk-of-ruin formula for fixed-fraction betting with a payoff ratio, from a named book or paper (author, title, page or DOI), and quote it.
Ruin = losing 50 % of the bankroll. Compute it for win rate 30, 35, 40, 45, 50, 55, 60, 65, 70 % x payoff ratio 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 3 x risk per trade 1, 2, 5 % (135 cells), to 4 decimals.
If your formula needs a simulation instead, say so, give the seed and 10,000 runs of 1,000 trades each.
tasks.done_when: 135 cells; Claude recomputes 20 at random with the same formula (within 0.005).
checks: A cell that does not follow the stated formula fails the file.

tasks.title: 30 rule checks Icarus can run on a trade, as formulas over its fields
tasks.why: Icarus records whether a trade kept the rules; it should also catch the common mistakes itself.
steps: Icarus's trade fields are: date, sym, side (long/short), qty, entry, exit, stop, fees, kept (yes/no), why (text).

Write 30 checks, each a formula over those fields only (plus the trades before it): e.g. 'no stop' = stop is empty; 'stop on the wrong side' = side=long and stop >= entry; 'revenge trade' = a loss closed the same day and the next trade's qty is more than 1.5x; 'loss past the stop' = side=long and exit < stop ...
For each: name, formula, the mistake it catches, and a source that describes that mistake (a trading-psychology book with page, or a paper DOI).
tasks.done_when: 30 checks, every formula uses only the fields named.
checks: Claude runs all 30 on the 20 trades in ICA-GEM-02; a formula that does not run fails the row.
